week_naming_note: The file name follows this repository's own weekly sequence (the previous snapshot is 2026-W48). The collection date 2026-11-21 falls in ISO week 2026-W47. The sequence and the ISO calendar have drifted apart since 2026-W47: the file 2026-W45 was collected 2026-11-08 (ISO W45), 2026-W46 on 2026-11-11 (ISO W46), 2026-W47 on 2026-11-15 (ISO W46) and 2026-W48 on 2026-11-20 (ISO W47). The name continues the sequence; the ISO week is recorded here so both are readable.

star_growth.baseline_note: Measured from the stargazer timeline: 281 stars carry a starred_at strictly before 2026-07-20T00:00:00Z, 282 including the star of 2026-07-20, and the 284th star arrived on 2026-07-31. The snapshots 2026-W45 through 2026-W48 all carried 284 under this label, so the carried figure matches the end of July rather than the baseline date. The monthly series is identical in both readings, so no star has been removed. The 30-day rate does not depend on the baseline: 7 stars over 30 days is 0.23 a day either way.

star_curve_monthly.note: New stars per calendar month, measured from the stargazer timestamps. The series is cumulative and has never fallen: no star has ever been unstarred in a way the timeline shows.

fork_state.note: The repository counter says 117; the network list returns 122, of which 115 are owned by a user account and 7 by an organization. Five forks carry something of their own — 2026-06-15, 2026-02-15, 2025-12-05 and 2025-08-05 hold a star each, 2026-04-01 holds a fork — so the previous snapshot's "every one of them is a passive clone" no longer holds. Four forks were created in the last 30 days (2026-11-16, 2026-11-14, 2026-10-29, 2026-10-28). The count of deletions in the last five days is not observable from the API and is therefore not recorded.

sitemaps.note: 2349 entries = 261 paths × 9 locales. The indexed counter reads 0 while the URL inspection reports the pages as submitted and indexed, so the counter is not a coverage statement. The 261 warnings are one per path-group and their type is not exposed by the API; the diagnosis is in docs/community/SEO_INDEXING_SETUP.md §1.7 — everything checkable from the API and from the live site is sound, and the warning text itself needs the operator's Search Console UI to read.

re_read.why: The same 28-day window read again the same day, through the corrected monitor (.claude/ops/monitor-gsc-traffic.ps1). Google finalises rows with a delay, so a fresh reading of an unchanged window carries more than the morning reading. The morning reading is kept above as it was measured; this block is the later one.

first_click.query_note: The page+query cut returns no row for this page at all, so Google withholds the query behind the click; the click is attributable to the page and to the date, not to a search term.

re_read.note: The site's first organic click, on 2026-11-20, one day after the demo became indexable. The property total (24 impressions) is the byProperty aggregate; the page rows sum to 33 because the http:// and https:// variants of a URL are counted separately there.

indexing.note: The property has no search data before 2026-11-11 and the demo was noindex until 2026-11-16, so these are the first impressions the site has ever produced. At collection time: twenty impressions in four days, no clicks, an average position of 39 — the pages are days old in the index. Re-read the same day: 24 impressions, the site's first click (2026-11-20) and an average position of 33.9.
